about: Past macro-event dates the pre-market brief uses as historical analogues. Compiled from the public schedules (RBI MPC resolutions, Union Budget days, Lok Sabha exit-poll and result days, US FOMC statements). The FY25, FY26 and FY27 RBI dates were checked against RBI's announced schedules on 3 Nov 2026; the rest are not yet checked line by line. A wrong date dilutes an analogue; it cannot reach a trade (the brief places nothing). Add new dates as they pass. Evidence strings count symbol-sessions (NIFTY and BANKNIFTY on one day are two) and pick options with what was known at the open.

rbi.label: RBI MPC decision
rbi.evidence: Exploratory, NIFTY and BANKNIFTY 2019-2026 bhavcopy (3 Nov 2026): on RBI days that were not expiry days, a near-money liquid option closed at 3x its open on 9.6% of symbol-sessions against 9.0% on other non-expiry sessions (73 symbol-sessions, 39 days). No difference. Not a tested rule.

fomc.label: US FOMC decision
fomc.evidence: Exploratory (3 Nov 2026): the Indian session after an FOMC decision was usually a Thursday expiry. On those, it spiked more often than other expiries on the same weekday: NIFTY 36% vs 22% (47 vs 268 symbol-sessions, z 2.0), BANKNIFTY 40% vs 18% (35 vs 201, z 2.9). On FOMC mornings that were not expiry days there was no 3x close in 44 symbol-sessions (28 days), against 9.0% usually: too few to say more. Not a tested rule.

budget.label: Union Budget
budget.evidence: Exploratory (3 Nov 2026): 20 symbol-sessions on 10 budget days since 2019, too few to say anything about spikes.

election.label: General election (exit polls, results)
election.evidence: Exploratory (3 Nov 2026): on the non-expiry exit-poll and result sessions of 2019 and 2024, 2 of 6 symbol-sessions had a near-money option close at 3x its open; 4 Jun 2024 ranks 68th and 80th of 3,858 symbol-sessions by the best close-to-open multiple. Rare: twice a decade.

geopolitics.label: Geopolitical shock (war, strikes, attacks)
geopolitics.evidence: Added 13 Nov 2026 (owner: 'what happened in the past in these kind of scenarios'). The first Indian session that could react to each episode: surgical strikes (29 Sep 2016), Balakot and the next day's air clash (26, 27 Feb 2019), Soleimani (3 Jan 2020), Iran's missiles on US bases (8 Jan 2020), Galwan (16 Jun 2020), Russia's invasion of Ukraine (24 Feb 2022), Hamas's attack on Israel (Sat 7 Oct 2023: 9 Oct), Iran's drones on Israel (Sat 13 Apr 2024: 15 Apr), Iran's missiles on Israel (1 Oct 2024, 2 Oct a holiday: 3 Oct), Pahalgam (22 Apr 2025: 23 Apr), Operation Sindoor (7 May 2025), Israel's strikes on Iran (13 Jun 2025), US strikes on Iran (Sun 22 Jun 2025: 23 Jun). Well-known dates, not yet checked line by line against a dated source.

oil_shock.label: Oil shock (supply attack, price war, OPEC+ surprise)
oil_shock.evidence: Added 13 Nov 2026. The first Indian session after: the Abqaiq attack (Sat 14 Sep 2019: 16 Sep), the Saudi-Russia price war (9 Mar 2020), US crude below zero (20 Apr 2020 US: 21 Apr), Brent near 139 dollars (7 Mar 2022), the OPEC+ surprise cut (Sun 2 Apr 2023: 3 Apr). Not yet checked line by line.
